source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of transgenic bacteria (PDF 163).

blocks.text: Bohat se mukhtalif jandaron ke genes plasmid mein jor kar bacteria mein dale ja sakte hain. Transgenic bacteria in bahar se dale gaye (foreign) genes ke proteins bari miqdar mein bana sakte hain. Mukhtalif transgenic bacteria in kaamon ke liye istemal ho rahe hain:

items: Dawaen (pharmaceutical products) banana, maslan insulin (diabetes ke ilaaj ke liye), human growth hormone (bauna pan, dwarfism, ke ilaaj ke liye) aur interferon (kuch cancers ke ilaaj ke liye). (Kitab is list mein clotting factors, hepatitis B vaccine, Covid-19 vaccine, erythropoietin aur tissue plasminogen activator bhi likhti hai; yeh doosre transgenic cells mein bante hain, neeche Kitab ki ghalti dekhein.)

Khane ki bohat si cheezein banana, maslan alpha-amylase (starch ko saada sugars mein badalta hai), chymosin (cheese banane ke liye doodh ke protein ko jamata hai) aur pectin-esterase (phalon ke juice ko saaf karta hai).
Aise enzymes banana jo zehreele maadde (toxins) tor kar aaloodgi (pollutants) ko kam zehreela bana dete hain.
Kachi dhaat (ore) se tamba (copper) nikalna, paare (mercury) ki aaloodgi saaf karna aur peene ke paani mein arsenic ka pata lagana.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke transgenic bacteria insulin ke saath clotting factors, hepatitis B vaccine, Covid-19 vaccine, erythropoietin aur tissue plasminogen activator (t-PA) bhi banate hain. Bacteria (E. coli) mein insulin, growth hormone aur interferon bante hain. Hepatitis B vaccine transgenic yeast (khameer) mein banti hai, aur erythropoietin, clotting factors aur t-PA zyada tar mammals ke transgenic cells mein bante hain, kyun ke in proteins par sugar groups lagne zaroori hain jo bacteria nahin laga sakte. Covid-19 ki bari vaccines bacteria mein nahin bantin: mRNA vaccines test tube mein banti hain, aur baqi janwaron, keeron (insects) ya yeast (khameer) ke cells mein.

blocks.prompt: Transgenic bacteria se banne wali do dawaen aur un se hone wala ilaaj batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do, maslan insulin (diabetes), human growth hormone (dwarfism) ya interferon (kuch cancers).

items: Transgenic bacteria plasmid mein dale gaye genes se bari miqdar mein proteins banate hain.
Istemal: dawaen, khane ke enzymes, toxins torne wale enzymes, copper nikalna, mercury saaf karna, arsenic pakarna.
